figures.claim: In the knee it is between two and six millimetres thick, thickest behind the kneecap.
- Articular cartilage is two to six millimetres thick, thickest behind the kneecap.

Composition is approximately seventy to eighty per cent water by wet weight, with type two collagen forming the bulk of the dry weight and proteoglycans, chiefly aggrecan, retained within that network.
Chondrocytes occupy roughly two per cent of the tissue volume and maintain the matrix.
